verdict.rationale: Obsidian has no documented first-party AI. The only on-topic evidence is a single community report that third-party AI plugins exist: the Text-Generator plugin can pull links and backlinks into an LLM's context. The same commenter says no AI plugin offers decent RAG, so in-product AI insights depend on unofficial community plugins with limited capability. Missing for 10: native or official AI insights and suggestions, documented retrieval over vault data, first-party docs, and broader independent corroboration.
